inputs.goal:
Build a COMPLETE browser-based multiplayer Doom-style FPS game.

REQUIRED FILES (create ALL 6 before calling done):
1. doom-fps/package.json - with express and socket.io
2. doom-fps/server.js - Node.js + Socket.IO multiplayer server  
3. doom-fps/public/index.html - game HTML page
4. doom-fps/public/game.js - FULL raycasting 3D engine with walls, WASD+mouse, multiplayer sync, shooting
5. doom-fps/Dockerfile - containerize the server
6. doom-fps/docker-compose.yml - easy deployment

VERIFICATION (do ALL before calling done):
1. Run: cd doom-fps && npm install
2. Start server: node server.js (in background)
3. curl http://localhost:3000 - verify HTML served
4. curl http://localhost:3000/game.js - verify JS served

DO NOT call done until ALL files exist AND server is verified running.
